text: Tenderer must hold a valid LUSA qualification for the relevant field of activity.
Tenderer must hold valid liability insurance for its operations with cover of at least EUR 1,000,000.
Tenderer must hold electrical contracting rights (sahkourakointioikeudet) of at least class S2.
Inspection of building envelope condition (rakennuksen vaipan kunnon tarkastus) must be addressed.
Continuity of service through staff changes (palvelun jatkuvuus henkilostomuutoksissa) must be addressed.
Reporting practice to the client (raportointikaytanto tilaajalle) must be addressed.
Quality control and testing procedures must be addressed.
Periodic statutory inspections of electrical installations (sahkoasennusten maaraaikaistarkastukset) must be addressed.
Compliance of elevator servicing with regulations (hissien huollon maaraystenmukaisuus) must be addressed.
Worker qualification requirements on site must be addressed.
Warranty period for installed equipment (asennettujen laitteiden takuuaika) must be addressed.
Price indexation clause (hintojen indeksiehto) must be addressed.
A cost breakdown requirement must be addressed.
Pricing currency must be addressed.
Invoicing frequency and format (laskutustiheys ja -muoto) must be addressed.
A certificate of pension insurance payments (todistus elakevakuutusmaksuista) must be enclosed with the quotation.
An insurance certificate (vakuutustodistus) must be enclosed with the quotation.
Submission deadline time zone and exact time must be observed (6 October 2026, 15:00 EET).
Reference currency for framework agreement pricing must be stated as required.
File format: quotation must be a single PDF file with no password protection.
Training of the buyer's property staff (tilaajan kiinteistohenkilokunnan koulutus) must be addressed.
A method statement for installation works (asennustoiden menetelmaselostus) must be addressed.
Spare parts availability and delivery time (varaosien saatavuus ja toimitusaika) must be addressed.
Servicing of fire-protection systems (palontorjuntajarjestelmien huolto) must be addressed.
Binding, non-negotiable condition: if the tenderer cannot demonstrate round-the-clock (24/7) on-call duty within Finland, the tender will be rejected regardless of price.
Transparency of subcontractor costs (aliurakoitsijoiden kustannusten lapinakyvyys) must be addressed.
